'''Tilas Magore''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|adviser]] to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FBS" /> He was responsible for overseeing the subjugation of [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lesan Ramier]] reported to him.<ref name="FBS" />
